integrity: General algebraic proof supplied; 49 direct finite computations over four field sizes supplement but do not prove the infinite statement. The Fortuin–Kasteleyn identity is classical and is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: The radical of the quiver algebra has square zero; varying finite-field sizes are necessary to reconstruct the Tutte polynomial. The element-order profiles do not recover arrow orientations, loop locations, or the complete graph isomorphism type. Historical equivalence cannot be excluded.
title: Unit-order profiles and Tutte reconstruction for radical-square-zero quiver algebras
